translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: SAN LUCAS
book.title: An alhua’ cau thuchath c’al an t’ocat inic Lucas

content: An jalpith cau c’al an t’ojonthanchix tumin axi yab bajuth
A Jesús in uchaye in exobalilchic: ―C’uajatac jun i rico inic in cua’al jun i t’ojonthanchix tumin, ani olchinal abal jolat pacucunchab in tuminal.
Tam in caniy ca chich an t’ojonthanchix ani in ucha’: Tata’ ojni’ tin jolat pacucunchamal u tuminal. Tiquin huat’banchits an cuenta, cum yabats ne’ets tu jila’ tit t’ojonthanchix c’al u tuminal.

Tam in lej tsalpachical tin ichich: ¿Jant’o ne’ets cu t’aja’ cum yabats ne’ets quim pithan an t’ojlab ax u t’ajalac? Yab in tsapnel cu t’ojonchi an tsabal ani in tithebel cu conchi i ts’ejhualixtalab.
Xo’ u tso’obits jant’o ne’ets cu t’aja’ abal cu co’oy u ja’ub jita’ tiquim bats’u tin q’uima’.
Tam in caniy ca chich ti junchic ax u nenchix c’al in amujac. Axi oc’ox chich in conoy: ¿Jant’o a nenchal u amujac?
Toc’tsin: U nenchal bo’ inic i tambor i aceite. Tam uchan: Te c’uajat an cuenta. Thubat quit buxcan te ca thucha’ expith tsab inic c’al lajuj a nenchal.

Tam conoyat junaque i nenchix: ¿Ani tata’ jant’o a nenchal u amujac? Toc’tsin: Bo’ inic i doble an lab em jats u nenchal. Tam uchan: Te c’uajat an cuenta. Ca ts’ejca’ tse’ inic i doble jats a nenchal.

Aba ani’ yab pututh c’al jahua’ antsana’ in t’ajamal nixe’ xi inic t’ojonthanchixac tumin, bel in amujac in ulu abal lej tsalpath jahua’ in t’ajamal c’al an nenchixchic. Antsana’ más lej tsalpath axi yab exlom c’al a Dios c’al jahua’ hua’ats teje’ tsabal, ani yab tsalpath axi exlomchic c’al a Dios c’al jahua’ hua’ats ti eb c’al a Dios.

Nan tu uchalchic abal jahua’ a cua’al teje’ ti al an hualab c’ay’lal ca alhua’ eyentha’ abal ca tolmiy an inicchic, ani tam ta ca taley jahua’ hua’ats teje’ tsabal ne’ets ca co’oy a ja’ub c’al quit junax otsits ti eb quit c’uajiy abal ets’ey.

Jitats quin alhua’ eyentha’ ax in cua’alits hue’, max ca pithan yan jayetseq’ui ne’ets quin alhua’ eyentha’. Jitats yab quin alhua’ eyentha’ ax in cua’alits hue’, max ca pithan yan jayetseq’ui yab ne’ets quin alhua’ eyentha’.
Max yab ca alhua’ eyentha’ jahua’ a Dios ti pithal ti al an hualab c’ay’lal, yab ne’ets ti pitha’ jahua’ lej huinat alhua’ ti eb.
Max yab ca alhua’ beletna’ jahua’ a Dios ti pithal ca beletna’, yab ne’ets ti pitha’ jahua’ bijithits ne’ets ti pitha’ ta lej chubax c’al.

Yab a ejtohualchic ca co’oy tsab i amulab, cum ne’ets ca c’athpich c’anitha’ axi jun ani axi jun iba. Ne’ets ca putu c’al in uchbixtal c’al axi jun ani c’al axi jun iba. Ni abal jay yab a ejtohual ca c’anitha’ a Dios ani jaye ca t’ajat c’anitha’ an tumin.
An fariseochic in ats’a’ abal antsana’ in ulu a Jesús, ani cum pel i lej jaylomchic c’al an tumin tocat in tilibnanchalq’ui.

Tam a Jesús in ucha’chic: ―Tata’chic ojni’ c’al jahua’ a t’ajal, expith abal a le’ max quit exla tit alhua’ inicchic c’al a at inic, ani a Dios jats ti lej exlanchal a lej ey ta ichich. Hua’ats i t’ajbilab ax u tsu’tab ti lej alhua’ c’al an inic, ani c’al a Dios u tsu’tab ti yab alhua’.
An ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés ani an cau tin cuenta abal a Dios in t’ajal ti Ts’ale

Ma ti lej biyalits ani ma tam ti chichits a Juan pujax u aynab an ts’ejcath c’au binath c’al a Moisés ani in exobchixtal axi ti biyal an caulomechic c’al a Dios. Ani a Juan jats in lej olnamal abal a Dios ne’ets quin t’aja’ ti lej Ts’ale teje’ tsabal, ani xo’ yan i inicchic in canat lubal ca otsits taja’.
Más thubat ne’ets ca taley an tsabal ani an eb, ani an ts’ejcath cau in cahuintal a Dios ma ni hue’ yab ne’ets ca taley jayq’ui’ ni jun i letra.
A Jesús in exobchal tin cuenta an jilcacaxtalab c’al i tomquilab
Jitats quin jilcacay in tomquil ani ca tomquin c’al q’ue’at i uxum, tamna’ pel i uxumbe. Ani jitats ca tomquin c’al i uxum axi jilcacath, tamna’ pel i uxumbe jaye.
An rico inic ani a Lázaro
Cahue a Jesús in ulu: C’uajatac jun i rico inic ax u toltomnal c’al i huinat alhua’ toltom ani lej ts’alat c’apul ti patal q’uicha.
C’uajatac jaye jun i ts’ejhuantal inic im bij Lázaro, ani lej t’it’lith tim puhuel in inictal. Hualim quetel tin hui’lebil tin q’uima’ an rico quin aychi max ca pithan jant’oquitsq’ui.
Ma in le’ac max ca pithan an mu’mach pan ax in ijcachical an rico ba’ an mexa. Tats tu che’el i pic’o’chic c’al ca lec’onchat in t’it’al a Lázaro.
Jun a q’uicha tsemetsits an ts’ejhuantal, ani ne’tha c’al an ángelchic ca c’uajiy jun ti c’uajat a Abraham tin ts’alat coytal a Dios. Taley tsemetsits jaye an rico ani joliyat.
Ani tocat in yajchicnal ti al an tamtsemla. Ani ma taja’ in tsu’u ou ti c’uajat a Abraham ani jaye a Lázaro.

Ani in thajat ulu: Pay’lom Abraham, tiquin yajnanchi. Tiquin abchi a Lázaro quin tsabay in ch’uchub c’ubac al i ja’ abal ca chich tiquin tsamambethanchi in chum u lec’ab. Cum te in c’uajat tocat u lej yajchicnal al axe’ xi c’amal.

Tam uchan an rico c’al a Abraham: Pay’lom, ca lej t’ila’ abal a huat’amal lej alhua’ a q’uicha ti tsabal ani a Lázaro in huat’amal lej yajchic. Xohue’ a Lázaro lej alhua’ in huat’al teje’, ani tata’ a huat’al lej yajchic tihua’.
Ani cum hua’ats ejtil i luputh quexat jol ts’ejel c’al huahua’, axi te c’uajatchic yab in ejtohual ca c’ale tihua’ aba ani’ in le’ac. Jaye axi tihua’ c’uajatchic yab in ejtohual ca chich teje’.
Tam toc’tsin an rico: Pay’lom Abraham, nan tu lej pacabethal ca aba’ a Lázaro ti olchix tin q’uima’ u tata.
Quin olchi axi bo’ u ebchal an chubaxtalab abal yab ca ulits teje’ al axe’ xi c’uajattalab lej yajchic.
Tam uchan c’al a Abraham: In cua’alits a ebchalchic an u jahua’ thuchath c’al a Moisés ani c’al an caulomechic c’al a Dios. Jats quin lej t’aja’chic ti cuenta jahua’ in ulal.
Toc’tsin an rico: Pay’lom Abraham, max jaja’chic ca tsa’biyat c’al jita’ pelac i tsemelom ani xo’ ejthachits, tam ojni’ ne’ets ca jic’tson c’al in hualabchic ani ca huenc’on c’al a Dios.
Toc’tsin a Abraham: Max yab im belamalchic jahua’ thuchath c’al a Moisés ani c’al an caulomechic c’al a Dios, jaye max ca ejtha i tsemelom yab ne’ets quim bela’.
